<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex87032023-03-1610-25-32">
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs></note> na re rgyu 'bras nges par byed pa'i tshad ma ni <abbr>thams cad</abbr> du ma dmigs pa dang dmigs pa'i mngon suM lnga kho nas yin te | 'di ltar dang <lb n="52b3"/> po rgyu 'bras gnyis ka ma dmigs pa dang | de nas rgyu dmigs pa dang | de nas 'bras bu dmigs pa dang | de nas rgyu log pas rgyu ma dmigs pa dang | de nas 'bras bu log pas 'bras bu ma dmigs pa'i mngon sum mo zhes zer ro || <!--This view is already mentioned in <mentioned>bsDus pa</mentioned> 142a8-142b1 (kha cig gzhung las gsungs pa'i mi dmigs pa dang dmyigs pa'i mngon sum lngas de'i mtshan nyid rjes 'gro dang ldog pa nges pa yin no zhes zer ro ||). It is also the view supported in <mentioned>rNam bshad</mentioned> 333,3-4 (mngon sum dang myi dmyigs pa rnam pa lngas rgyu 'bras kyi mtshan nyid nges pas de kho na tshad ma yin no ||).-->
                de ni mi 'thad de | <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">khyung</rs></note> gnas skabs kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mthong pa'i tshad ma lngas nges pa yin nam 'on te rang bzhin gyi rjes su 'gro ldog mthong pa'i tshad ma lngas nges pa yin | dang po ltar na rnga'i sgra dang nyi ma'i 'od zer yang rgyu <lb n="52b4"/> 'bras su thal te gnas skabs kyi rjes su 'gro ldog lan brgyar mthong pa'i phyir ro || gnyis pa ltar na tshad ma lnga yis ci zhig bya ste rang bzhin gyi rjes su 'gro ldog mthong pa'i tshad ma gsuM gyis rjes 'gro dngos su nges pas ldog pa shugs la 'phen pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
